speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: He offered to send you to the North Pole?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yes. In fact, he was quite enthusiastic. He said," Frankly, if I could send you tonight, I would."

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, well, do you want to go?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Of course not. I'm a theoretical physicist, a career I chose in no small part because it's indoors, but if I'm able to detect slow-moving magnetic monopoles there, I will be the scientist to confirm string theory. People will write books about me. Third-graders will create macaroni-art dioramas depicting scenes from my life.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sure, maybe a tableau of me trying to pummel you to death.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm on the horns of a dilemma. Can you imagine me, Sheldon Cooper, at the North Pole?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Easy peasy, I'm doing it right now.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm not good with cold, Leonard. How often have we had to leave a movie theatre because I got a headache from drinking the Icee too fast? I can't go. How can you say that? The scientific opportunity of a lifetime presents itself and my best friend says don't go. Listen to you.
